claims.claim: All 8 bare path references (S1) resolve to existing files
claims.evidence: CRITICAL: The baseline run found 8 broken S1 references (stale %20-encoded spike links, wrong-depth relative path) that the with-skill run missed entirely. The skill's grep pattern only matches bare paths like 'features/x/y.md' — it misses URL-encoded paths and relative paths like '../ledgers/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md'

claims.claim: All 7 builds-on targets resolve to existing files
claims.evidence: The baseline found 3 broken S2 references in _workflow/ docs. The skill's S2 grep only checks 'Product/features/' — it excludes _workflow/ docs entirely

suggestions.reason: The skill passed all 4 format assertions but missed 11 real findings the baseline caught. The assertions only check report structure, not correctness of the scan. A critical assertion is missing: 'The skill finds the same real broken references as a thorough manual check' — i.e., coverage of URL-encoded paths, relative paths, and _workflow/ docs in S2.

eval_feedback.overall: Assertions pass but mask the most important failure: the skill's grep patterns are too narrow and produce false negatives.
